    # Reduce number of buckets to minimize cat/split overhead
    num_buckets = 3
    
    num_tensors = len(grads)

    outs = [None] * num_tensors
    
    for bucket_idx in range(num_buckets):
        start_idx = bucket_idx * tensors_per_bucket
        end_idx = min(start_idx + tensors_per_bucket, num_tensors)
        
        if start_idx >= num_tensors:
            break
        
        bucket_tensors = grads[start_idx:end_idx]

        sizes = [t.numel() for t in bucket_tensors]
        shapes = [t.shape for t in bucket_tensors]

        splits = reduced.split(sizes)
